## How it was tested

- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test that fails without the change
- [ ] Safety rule added or changed: a mutant in `tools/mutation.py` is killed by a named test
- [ ] Roof shapes or chat output changed: screenshots regenerated (`runClientGameTest` + `branding/make_media.sh`) and looked at
